eras.title: Kevin Garnett era
intro: This stretch is the franchise’s emotional spine: a teenager who became an MVP, a conference finals run, and years of fighting the West with rosters that were sometimes thin but rarely boring.
Use the links below to jump into seasons, the head coach most associated with the peak, and Garnett’s player profile with full career tables from NBA.com.
